main.description: A group's shared space, for one occasion such as a wedding or a class trip. The person who started the group is the space's authority, and each group gets its own random space key. Its members can see each other and everything shared into it. Every record in it, including the group's app.logdate.space.groupProfile and its app.logdate.space.member records, is an app.logdate.crypto.sealed envelope.
main.name: LogDate groups
